gloss: with a flat plop; flatly; sitting flat on the ground

definitions.gloss: with a flat plop; flatly; sitting or sticking flat
definitions.explanation: Describes something making full, flat contact with a surface in a single soft motion — a person flopping down to sit, a sticker pressed flat, or a hand laid flat against something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぺたんと⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: I plopped down on the floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦シール→シール：09597_shiiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぺたんと⟦{貼|は}った→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: I stuck the sticker on flat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧、ぺたんと⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}り{込|こ}んで→座り込む：04641_suwarikomu⟧しまった。
examples.english: The child got tired and plopped down on the ground.

notes:
Mimetic of a single soft, flat contact — a one-shot sound, in contrast to the repeated ⟦ぺたぺた→ぺたぺた：05376_petapeta⟧. The image is of something settling flat against a surface without bouncing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ぺたんと⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to plop down flat (often with legs to one side)
- ぺたんと⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to stick on flat
- ぺたんと⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to set down flat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぺたぺた→ぺたぺた：05376_petapeta⟧: repeated flat slapping or sticking sounds
- ぺったり: in close, flat contact (more about the resulting state)
- どすん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: with a heavy thud — louder, heavier contact
- ぱたん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: with a clack (a hinged thing closing)
